title: Project PlaceHolder
tagline: PlaceHolder is an on demand NFT based advertising platform for product / website owners via streamable cash flows.
description:
Advertisers have to spend enormous amounts of money for very little advertising space.

Provides flexibility for advertisers to start and stop advertisement campaigns better suited for their budget and timing
Improves capital efficiency as it allows granular control over the time and money spent.

Directly incentivising users for interacting with AdsDrip NFTs.

Adding additional revenue streams for project / website owners with a flexible mechanism.
